name: Huaxin Resources Technology Co. Ltd.
summary: Huaxin Resources Technology Co. Ltd. provides solid waste resource utilization, treatment, and disposal services in China. The company offers electronic waste and scrap motor vehicle dismantling, and waste electronic equipment recycling services. It provides recycling and dismantling of televisions, refrigerators, air conditioners, washing machines, computers, range hoods, electric water heaters, gas water heaters, printers, copiers, fax machines, monitors, mobile phones, and telephones; disposal of hazardous waste; and community garbage classification and recycling of primary commodities.
